svg.title: Horizontal scaling
svg.desc: Readers send traffic through a load balancer to a single app server that is nearly maxed out. Three identical copies join, the balancer spreads requests across all four, and every load bar drops to about a quarter. Then one copy dies, the other three pick up its share, and the site keeps serving.

g.text: one dies, the rest carry on

svg.text: More copies, less load on each. Losing one costs a slice, not the site.
